commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

90+4' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Moritz Nicolas inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the left side of the target, but was denied by a great save.
90+3' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Shio Fukuda (B. Monchengladbach) is coming onto the pitch as Lukas Ullrich cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90+2' Two players stand over the free kick. Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
90+1' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
88' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

88' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and attempts to place his header into the middle of the goal. Moritz Nicolas shows his fast reflexes, though, and makes a nice save.

88' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) gets inside the box and tries to beat Moritz Nicolas with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
87' The corner from Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) is cleared away by the defence.

84' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the roof of the net, but Moritz Nicolas is alert and denies him with a nice save.

82' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
